item.text: The file content is already JPEG-encoded even though it has a `.raw` extension, which is why GIMP’s normal open path is choosing the RAW/Pentax loader and failing. I’m going to invoke GIMP’s JPEG loader directly and export it as a proper `.jpg` on the Desktop.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "gimp -i -b '(let* ((image (car (file-jpeg-load RUN-NONINTERACTIVE \"/home/user/Desktop/yicun.raw\" \"/home/user/Desktop/yicun.raw\"))) (drawable (car (gimp-image-get-active-layer image)))) (file-jpeg-save RUN-NONINTERACTIVE image drawable \"/home/user/Desktop/yicun.jpg\" \"/home/user/Desktop/yicun.jpg\" 0.95 0 1 1 \"\" 0 1 0 2) (gimp-image-delete image))' -b '(gimp-quit 0)'"
